title: User function body with per-branch local writes then return — pass 20 branch relax
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Function body has branches with `variable := expr` followed by `return variable`. Pre-pass-20 the branch-shape check demanded `Tasks.Count == 1` (single Return); this shape fell to UserFunctionBlackBox. Pass 20 relaxes TryInlineIfElseAsMux to accept `[Operation*, ReturnStatement]` — the per-branch local writes use a pushed scope frame so branch A's alias doesn't leak into branch B. Expected: sel='1' → y = a; sel='0' → y = b (semantically same as 152, but tests the branch-with-local shape).
